headline: Exploring New Milford, Connecticut This Autumn
subhead: From Candlewood Lake to the historic town green, here is what New Milford offers.
caption: New Milford offers a mix of open space, waterfront access, and historic charm along the Housatonic River. In October, the foliage around Lovers Leap State Park and Candlewood Lake is at its peak. The downtown area features Connecticut's longest town green, flanked by local shops and dining along Bank Street. Route 7 and Route 202 provide straightforward access across Litchfield County and south to Danbury's shopping corridors and Interstate 84. Whether you are interested in lakefront neighborhoods or a place close to the center of town, New Milford has diverse housing options. Send me a message to see current market numbers and available homes in New Milford.

hook_say: New Milford is actually the largest town by land area in Connecticut.

scenes.label: The Green
scenes.title: Historic Downtown and Bank Street
scenes.detail: Bank Street features local dining, an independent movie theater, and Connecticut's longest town green.
scenes.say: I love grabbing coffee on Bank Street and walking around Connecticut's longest town green.

scenes.label: Outdoors
scenes.title: Lovers Leap State Park
scenes.detail: Scenic hiking trails overlook the Housatonic River alongside the historic 1895 red truss bridge.
scenes.say: Lovers Leap State Park offers great hiking trails with incredible foliage along the Housatonic River.

scenes.label: Lakes
scenes.title: Candlewood Lake and Lillinonah
scenes.detail: Town residents enjoy boat launches and lakefront access at Lynn Deming Park on Candlewood Lake.
scenes.say: You have easy water access right here, between Candlewood Lake and Lake Lillinonah.

scenes.label: Commute
scenes.title: Highway Access via Route 7
scenes.detail: Route 7 provides a direct route south to Danbury, Interstate 84, and regional train lines.
scenes.say: Route 7 gives you a straightforward drive down to Danbury and Interstate 84.
